description: This file defines the TemplateTextArea class, a PHP class extending TemplateText, used within the SuiteCRM framework to handle textarea fields in dynamic forms. It provides methods for setting field properties, rendering detail views, and generating field definitions.

classes.name: TemplateTextArea
classes.description: A PHP class representing a template for a textarea field within SuiteCRM, extending the TemplateText class and providing additional properties and methods for handling textarea-specific behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateTextArea object and maps 'rows' and 'cols' properties to external variables 'ext2' and 'ext3'.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets properties of the object from provided values, including 'rows', 'cols', and 'default_value' based on external variables.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the detail view representation of the textarea field's content, converting newlines to HTML line breaks.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates and returns the field definition array, including 'rows' and 'cols' attributes.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns null because TEXT fields in MySQL cannot have default values; defers handling to the Bean.
